name: Burr

facts.text: Burr is a named drakulv (the named drakulv's model, large) held by two spawns in Malmohus: a level-47 in the west (692,622/983,068) with no faction, and a level-48 in the middle (729,165/994,461) of the Pack Drakulv faction near a patrolling drakulv and an armguard.
facts.source: runtime/data/opendaoc.sqlite3.db, Mob and NpcTemplate tables (0.37b world data)

facts.text: Old Norse burr is a poetic word for 'son'.
Burr's name and its two holders are Living Server lore (the drakulv name custom).

story:
Burr means son, in the old poets' tongue, and the drakulv give it to the hollow's youngest name-holder: the one who will do the work the older ones are too slow for. There are two of them. The beam-cutters of Svarhamr say a drakulv is born nameless and the hollow gives it a name with its work, and when it dies another takes the work and the name; some names are held twice. Burr is held twice because the work is twice: one Burr in the west watches the road the companies take south, and one in the middle runs with the patrols near the dragon's hollow.

The western Burr belongs to no pack now. Brisa of Svarhamr says he was the son who did not come when Gunnolf refused the dragon's runners, and that the pack let him keep the name and nothing else. The middle Burr is the pack's still, and the patrols answer him. Both are young, both are large, and both fight like what the name says: a son with something to prove.
legend: Burr is two named drakulv in Malmohus: a 47 in the west, alone and with no faction, and a 48 in the middle on Pack Drakulv faction near a patrolling drakulv and an armguard, which may be in the fight. Same name, two spawns, both plain heavy hitters. The western one is the easier kill. Old Malmohus hands say if one Burr is down, check the other before you call it.

slay: (He shakes the blood from his jaws.)

lairEntry: A young named drakulv, larger than the rest.
